dialect.detail: IBM CICS/VSAM online program; uses DFHAID, DFHBMSCA, DFHCOMMAREA, EIBRESP, DFHRESP, EIBCALEN, EIBTRNID, EIBAID — classic IBM CICS BMS conventions
evidence: EXEC CICS SEND MAP / RECEIVE MAP
EXEC CICS STARTBR / READNEXT / ENDBR FILE('EDP3CR')

purpose.domain_detail: Credit master file browser (Maestro de Créditos) — likely a Guatemalan banking/microfinance application ('SEMILLERO' training project by instructor 'DON EDGAR')
purpose.summary: Online CICS program that browses a VSAM credit master file (EDP3CR) and displays paginated results on a BMS map (EDCLQ). It supports forward/backward paging via PF5/PF6, cursor-based selection, and XCTL transfer to EDGD1CL3. The program manages screen page state via COMMAREA.

notable_features: EXEC CICS BMS map send/receive (EDCLQ mapset)
Bidirectional paging logic (PF5 forward, PF6 backward) with saved key arrays in COMMAREA
OCCURS 15 key-save array for multi-page navigation
EIBAID function key evaluation (DFHPF5, DFHPF6, DFHPF7, DFHPF10, DFHENTER)
COPY of DFHAID, DFHBMSCA, EDMACR, EDCLQ
